name: Build lantern-native against the current Chaos
body:
Dean (2026-11-14): mist install fails on macOS building lantern-native: ChaosUiBridge.cpp:539 error: no member named 'GameEngine' in 'Chaos::ChaosBuildTarget'.

Cause: engine/native/src/ChaosUiBridge.cpp uses the GameEngine build target (added in chaos-ui-framework eec600c, copied over from crates/chaos-ui in #65), but mist.lock still pins chaos-ui-framework at 74c7f61, which predates it, so mist builds the new source against the old Chaos. Chaos proto has not removed anything: GameEngine is there, with UmbraEngine kept as an alias.

Fix: refresh mist.lock so chaos-ui-framework, cosmos-styling-language, nyx-scripting-language and penumbra-bridge follow their branches again, and check the bridge compiles against the new heads.
acceptance_criteria: mist install builds lantern-native from a clean mist.lock refresh.
ChaosUiBridge.cpp compiles against the current chaos, cosmos, nyx and penumbra-bridge heads.
